parameters.name: corporation_id
parameters.description: Id of the Corporation whose pending tasks are returned (the Corporation owning the validator Participant entries). Which of its operators may execute a pending action is resolved separately against the Corporation's authorization grants

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of ecosystems to return

parameters.name: trust_data
parameters.description: Trust data enrichment mode for DID-bearing objects: null (default), summary, or full.

parameters.name: At-Block-Height
parameters.description: Header to query historical state at a specific block height. When provided, returns the state as it was when the specified block finished processing. When omitted, returns the latest indexed state. Must be a positive integer not exceeding the current indexed block height.
